newsitem.title: UK: Telewest likely to raise $300 mln - report.
newsitem.headline: Telewest likely to raise $300 mln - report.

text.p: British cable operator Telewest Communications Plc is preparing to raise $300 million through the issue of junk bonds, the Times said on Wednesday.
The newspaper quoted analysts as saying the new debt was likely to be expensive and could trigger a slide in the share price.
Telewest closed on Tuesday at 90 1/2 pence.
The group raised about $1.2 billion in junk bonds in 1995.
The fresh funds could be used to convert its networks to digital technology and for digital set-top boxes for cable TV customers, the newspaper said.
The group disappointed the market in March by reporting increased losses before tax of 249.9 million pounds ($405.9 million) from 114.67 pounds in the previous year. ($ = 0.615 British Pounds)
